name: overlay-assistant
description: Floating overlay meeting assistant with live Deepgram transcription and Anthropic AI assistance

scripts.build: electron-packager . "Meeting Notes" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --asar --ignore="^/dist" --ignore="\.zip$" && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path '.env' -Destination 'dist/Meeting Notes-win32-x64/.env' -Force; Copy-Item -Path 'config' -Destination 'dist/Meeting Notes-win32-x64/config' -Recurse -Force"
